onboardingSubtitle: See who doesn't follow you back — in three steps.
onboardingStep1Body: Go to Instagram or GitHub and open your profile's followers or following list.
onboardingStep2Body: Click the FollowLens icon and press "Start Auto-Collect". The list scrolls itself; a small badge on the page shows progress and a Stop button.
onboardingStep3Body: When the counter stops growing, save the scan. From the second scan on you'll see exactly who unfollowed you, who's new, and who doesn't follow back.
